description: Turns a Raspberry Pi Zero into a hardware-level automation and telemetry bridge for macOS, emulating a composite USB keyboard/mouse/serial/Ethernet gadget so control and automation work below the OS's scripting and accessibility permission layers.
highlights: Multiplexes USB keyboard, mouse, media keys, serial, and Ethernet over a single USB OTG cable via a composite gadget
End-to-end encrypted control channel using ephemeral P-256 ECDH key exchange and AES-256-GCM, with the Go relay never seeing decrypted payloads
Passwordless WebAuthn (TouchID/FaceID) authentication with temporary setup-code enrollment
Hybrid routing: sub-millisecond WebSocket queries, high-frequency ACM serial telemetry, and an SSH pool with WiFi failover
